assertions.assert: <conversation:commit> takes location, direction (exactly inbound or outbound), event, message and sequence, optionally keylocation and provenance, no other attribute and no content: a malformed element raises error.execution and assigns nothing (its schema, package/conversation.xsd, rejects it before any run under scx validate).

The committed message is {sequence, direction, source_ids, target_ids, content, content_type, provenance}, without the message's other members; inbound audio content is null, other content is kept as given, and absent content is null.

The relationship context reference is {"identity_groups":[...]} over the sorted source and target identity groups, the same in either direction, written to keylocation; without a provenance, an inbound message's session_ref is relationship-<reference> and an outbound one's is null.
A provenance's id, source, target and session_ref are taken when they are strings, else null, and its turn_ref is taken as given.
A malformed value (a negative sequence, an empty event, a message without a content_type) raises error.execution and assigns nothing.
